title: Haitian Brown Sugar Limeade (Sitwonad)
description: Fresh lime juice and light brown sugar make a tart, amber pitcher of Haitian-style limeade.
imageAlt: Pitcher and glass of amber limeade with ice and green limes
ingredients: ¾ cup packed light brown sugar, plus more to taste
1 cup freshly squeezed lime juice (about 6–8 limes)

steps.title: Dissolve the sugar
steps.text: Warm 1 cup of the water with the brown sugar, stirring just until dissolved. Let the syrup cool.

steps.title: Mix and taste
steps.text: Strain the lime juice into a pitcher. Stir in the cooled syrup and the remaining 4 cups water. Taste and add a little cold water or more brown sugar if needed.

steps.title: Pour over ice
steps.text: Fill glasses with ice, pour in the limeade, and add a lime wheel if you like.
